user.title: Feels-like temperature
user.description: Choose how the feels-like temperature is calculated. **Real feel (UTCI)** models how the weather actually feels on the skin outdoors (temperature, humidity, wind and sun) and works in every climate. The other methods are the classic indices many weather services use, each suited to a particular climate.

data_description.method: UTCI is recommended. Pick a classic index to match a familiar weather app or your old template.

sensors.title: Sensors
sensors.description: Pick the sensors to use. Units are converted automatically (°F, km/h, mph, knots…).

data.hold_time: Keep last value when a sensor drops out

data_description.temperature_entity: Air temperature measured in the shade.
data_description.wind_entity: Average wind speed (a smoothed/filtered sensor works best).
data_description.wind_mounting: The formulas expect wind measured 10 m above open ground. Wind is weaker near the ground, so it is scaled up by a factor based on the sensor height.
data_description.sun_source: Sun can make it feel 5–15 °C warmer. Use a solar radiation sensor if you have one; otherwise a light sensor or the cloud cover from a weather forecast entity.
data_description.min_update_interval: Input changes within this window are combined into one update. Feels-like changes slowly; longer windows mean fewer database writes.
data_description.precision: The models are only accurate to about a degree, so whole degrees are shown by default. Choose one decimal for finer steps.
data_description.hold_time: If a sensor becomes unavailable or reports an impossible value, its last good value is used for this long. After that the backup weather entity takes over, or the helper becomes unavailable.
data_description.backup_weather_entity: Used for temperature, humidity, wind and sun when a sensor has been out for longer than the time above. Forecast values can differ from your own sensors.

sun.title: Sun
sun.description: Configure the sun data and the ground around you.

data_description.irradiance_entity: Global solar radiation on a horizontal surface.
data_description.illuminance_entity: Outdoor light sensor, converted to W/m². Cheap sensors may saturate in bright sun.
data_description.lux_per_wm2: Daylight is about 120 lx per W/m².
data_description.weather_entity: The sun strength is estimated from the sun's position and the entity's cloud cover.
data_description.ground_surface: Sunlight reflected from the ground also warms you.
data_description.snow_entity: A binary sensor/input boolean that is on, or a snow depth sensor above 0, switches the ground to snow (strong reflection).

custom_wind.title: Custom wind factor
custom_wind.description: Factor that converts the measured wind to the wind at 10 m above open ground.

data_description.wind_factor: 1.0 for a 10 m mast, 1.5 for wind measured at face height.

error.temperature_unit: The temperature sensor does not report a temperature unit.
error.wind_unit: The wind sensor does not report a speed unit.
error.irradiance_unit: The solar radiation sensor must report W/m².
error.illuminance_unit: The light sensor must report lx.
error.weather_cloud_coverage: This weather entity does not provide cloud coverage.

options.utci: Real feel (UTCI) – all climates, includes sun
options.bom: Overcast / maritime (BoM apparent temperature) – cloudy, windy coasts and dry heat
options.four_season: Four seasons (wind chill ↔ apparent temperature) – like many weather apps
options.wind_chill: Cold and windy (wind chill) – cold winters, mountains
options.heat_index: Hot and humid (NWS heat index) – subtropical summers

options.weather: Estimate from weather forecast cloud cover

state.blend_wind_chill_bom: Blend of wind chill and apparent temperature
state.blend_air_temperature_bom: Blend of air temperature and apparent temperature

backup_inputs.name: Inputs from the backup weather entity
